title: Afri-MCQA: Multimodal Cultural Question Answering for African Languages

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the accuracy of Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) on a visually-grounded Question Answering benchmark (Afri-MCQA) focused on African cultural contexts, and comparing performance to general knowledge benchmarks to identify gaps in cultural representation.

Comparing model performance on question answering tasks when queries are presented in English versus 15 native African languages, across both text and speech modalities, and using diagnostic control experiments like language identification and automatic speech recognition.
